_: invoke-todos account config (docs/spec-config.md). Keys starting with _ are comments. Paths may start with ~. Everything omitted takes its default.

todoist._: where the API token comes from: env (TODOIST_API_TOKEN), keychain (macOS), file (mode 0600) or command (a program that prints it); the token itself never goes in this file

defaults._: the project the task verbs run under; --in PROJECT overrides it per run

projects._: the projects that are task lists and the areas (sections, one lowercase word each) they are expected to have

attributes._: the house vocabulary: labels for effort and mode, free kinds, what priority means

meaning.assisted: an agent starts it and needs you mid-way
meaning.owner: only you can: pay, sign, call

provenance._: src and since ride in one task comment; a session id in src becomes an Origin link through url_template (a %s template), or no link when null
